source.author: cic
source.text: etsi enim nihil habet in se gloria cur expetatur, tamen virtutem tamquam umbra sequitur.
source.text_original: etsi enim nihil habet in se gloria cur expetatur, tamen virtutem tamquam umbra sequitur.
source.text_english: For although glory has nothing in itself why it should be sought, nevertheless it follows virtue like a shadow.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: fugiendo gloriam gloriam merebatur, quae virtutem quasi umbra sequitur et appetitores sui deserens appetit contemptores.
reuse.text_original: fugiendo gloriam gloriam merebatur, quae virtutem quasi umbra sequitur et appetitores sui deserens appetit contemptores.
reuse.text_english: By fleeing glory, he was earning glory, which follows virtue like a shadow and, abandoning those who seek it, seeks those who despise it.
